title: Current Binary-DXF/modeler peer boundary and ACadSharp report reconciliation
scope: Refresh GDAL's current Binary-DXF and 3D extensibility boundaries against its historical known-issues page.
Reconcile ACadSharp issues #1297 and #1299 to existing local MTEXT/SPLINE owners and evidence gates.
Refine optional peer/native readiness without expanding routine validation or importing customer fixtures.

sources.name: GDAL current DXF driver documentation
observations: Binary-DXF input is documented starting with GDAL 3.12.
AC1027+ DXF_3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE exposes raw ASMData and a 12-real ASMTransform; the default reader skips 3DSOLID, REGION, BODY, and SURFACE.
The route is an OGR feature projection; spline geometry is tessellated and the driver does not convert ASM payloads to OGR B-rep geometry.

sources.name: GDAL historical DXF known-issues page
observations: The page is approximately eight years old and should not be used alone as the current capability matrix.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1297
observations: The report describes AutoCAD 2025 rejecting an AC1032 DWG with MTEXT frame-only flag 16 while reported flag 17 and AC1027 flag 16 controls open.
The issue reports a byte-identical MTEXT object after a correction while whole-file rejection remained; absent style objects are hypotheses, not an isolated cause.
The issue is peer DWG-writer/native evidence and does not establish a libdxfrw defect.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1299
observations: The report attaches source DWG and converted DXF and names ACadSharp NuGet 3.8.0, but does not identify the failing SPLINE handle/arrays, GDAL build/options, or independent expected curve.
The attached customer ZIP was not downloaded or inspected.

validation.scopedDiffCheck: PASS: git diff --check for plan; awk trailing-whitespace check for both receipts

assessment.localDisposition: Reuse existing generated MTEXT flag/version vectors, SPLINE controls, and composed native evidence gates; no new local defect or test was identified.
assessment.implementationSpeed: No optional peer, external drawing, native app, or full suite added to per-slice validation. Missing external evidence remains NOT_RUN/DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and must not stop local implementation.
